title: sprite-plausibility-v1 player output
description: Per-statistic SPRITE-style plausibility judgements. One record per reported statistic.

issue_kind.description: The impossibility kind when flagged=true; null otherwise. One of: impossible_mean (reported mean falls outside [scale_min, scale_max]), impossible_sd (reported SD exceeds the maximum SD attainable for bounded integers with that mean).

flagged.description: True if the reported (mean, SD) pair is impossible for N integers in [scale_min, scale_max].

confidence.description: Player's confidence in the flagged judgement.
